task: Close PR #3510 round 7 review by making the ratio bound tests non-tautological, bounding two min_sel messages, filing the pre-existing robustness follow-up, and merging the PR.

events.content: Created an isolated PR worktree to avoid unrelated dirty files in the main checkout.
Replaced the million-digit ratio tests with guards that assert the length-guard message and monkeypatch Decimal to prove parsing is not reached.
Replaced semantic truncation tests with marker and original-length assertions for strict range, test range, ratio sum, no-opt, and no-held-out paths.
Added a false test_ratio split-file case that fails if bool exclusion is removed from the legacy numeric schema detector.
Bounded min_sel in the core split error and the legacy numeric split error, then added long-value tests for both.
Ran scratch reverts for the three review findings plus both min_sel messages. Every changed regression test failed under its matching revert.
Filed issue #3641 for the five robustness gaps confirmed pre-existing on origin/main.
First push attempt failed only on missing retrospective evidence after running the full pre-push suite. This session log records the retrospective evidence and will be pushed in the second attempt.
